_settings_help: priority: higher wins when sources describe the same beach (county/state ~80-90, national portal 10). label: agency name for the official-page link. delayed: results arrive months late. status_only: source publishes status but no sample results. prune_unseen: remove this source's sites that a successful run no longer returns (only for sources that always return their full site list). site_kind: 'beach' or 'waterway' for sources whose sites are all one kind (portal stations are tagged individually).

wqp_nj._note: Water Quality Portal: all coastal monitoring stations (Ocean and Estuary site types, including tidal tributaries) with Enterococcus or E. coli results. Delays vary by agency.
wqp_nj.agency: NJDEP beach monitoring, via the Water Quality Portal
wqp_nj._robots_note: The portal's robots.txt disallows /data/ for crawlers, but /data/ is the portal's documented public web service for scripted downloads (also used by USGS's dataRetrieval software). This collector makes a few throttled requests per day with an identifying user agent. Set to true to honor robots.txt instead.
wqp_nj.label: New Jersey DEP
